answer: Each new identity locks a bond from a funding key frozen exclusive for 90 days, so that key cannot open a second seat. Peers may challenge a suspect by posting a matching counter-bond; the accused must sign a fresh nonce with that key in a short window. If the key also funded other seats, every sibling bond is slashed. A farm must lock one unshared capital unit per fake, and one reused key burns the cluster. A yarrow tag marks the exclusive key, a timber hold blocks withdrawal in the freeze, and a basalt-hard live nonce stops one wallet answering two challenges without exposing the shared key.
